title: conformance.Send
description: Makes the library send a request as an application would (the library's sender, the given options) and report the outcome.

target.description: probe: conformance.runner.Probe (command); probe-query: conformance.runner.ProbeQuery; missing: conformance.runner.Missing; echo, echo-query, shared-query: the service's own types; probe-stream: conformance.runner.ProbeStream; stream: conformance.Stream; probe-watch: conformance.runner.ProbeWatch; watch: conformance.Watch

payload.description: the request's payload (for the runner's types often a script)

timeoutMs.description: the caller's timeout; absent: the caller chose none

headers.description: headers the caller adds through the library's generic header option

retry.description: optional: a retry policy for this call only, for a library that takes one per call (answer result unsupported otherwise). The runner sets the policy for every send with CONFORMANCE_RETRY_* instead

read.description: stream, subscribe: stop after this many items (the initial result counts) and drop the stream or subscription

async.description: answer {opId} at once; the outcome comes from conformance.Outcome

result.description: unsupported: the library cannot do what was asked (reason says what); the check that asked then fails

payload.description: unary: the decoded reply ({} for a command without a result)

items.description: stream: the items in order; subscribe: the initial result, then the updates; also the items read before an error

end.description: completed: the stream or subscription ended; stopped: the caller stopped after read items (the library cancelled it)

parts.description: scatter: one per answer, in arrival order

elapsedMs.description: from the call to its outcome

kind.description: never-sent: the request was never handed to a stream's transport (no acknowledged stream, or still in the library's own buffer when the stream broke); outcome-unknown: handed to the transport, then the hub stream broke before the answer - also a stream or subscription the library sent whose hub stream was lost; code: an ErrorCode reached the caller, from the hub or a handler, and the library's local guard timeout, which is ErrorCode TIMEOUT (code says which); lost-parts: the library detected a gap in ReplyPart.seq or a ReplyEnd.parts above the parts received; refused: the library refused the call before sending it (a header it owns, ...); local: any other local failure

code.description: for kind code: the ErrorCode name the caller got (an unknown code reads as HANDLER_ERROR)

message.description: the error's message as the caller sees it

details.description: Error.details as UTF-8 text, when the caller kept them
